file:runs/kit/REQ-011/ci/INTEGRITY_EVAL.json
{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "req_id": "REQ-011",
  "verdict": "hardening_ready",
  "summary": "The candidate is structurally coherent, covers all five acceptance criteria with meaningful component tests backed by MSW fixtures, and follows the PLAN namespace layout faithfully. Source substance is adequate for a frontend UI REQ of this scope — types, API client, hooks, and three components form a complete inbox feature. Tests are well-organized and map explicitly to each acceptance criterion. The main weaknesses are: (1) the page.tsx uses a hardcoded placeholder user instead of consuming the shared auth context seam from REQ-002/REQ-004, (2) the read-state polling test (AC-5) is structurally weak and does not actually prove polling behavior, (3) no E2E smoke exists even as a deferred placeholder script, and (4) the TaskRow uses a plain `<a>` tag instead of Next.js `Link` for client-side navigation, which contradicts the 'without full page reload' acceptance criterion. These are all addressable in hardening without redesign.",
  "scope_fidelity": {
    "status": "strong",
    "notes": [
      "All five acceptance criteria are explicitly addressed in both source and tests",
      "Task inbox lists open tasks with document_id, task type, status badge, creation time, and assignment",
      "State badges cover all five workflow states with Italian labels and color coding",
      "Document detail navigation link is present on each task row",
      "Retry action is conditionally rendered based on task type and user permission",
      "Read state is tracked via localStorage and reflected visually without page reload",
      "Italian labels are used throughout operator-visible text"
    ]
  },
  "source_substance": {
    "status": "adequate",
    "notes": [
      "8 source files covering types, API client, 2 hooks, 3 components, and 1 page — proportionate to the REQ scope",
      "Types mirror backend DTOs correctly including all five document statuses and task types",
      "API client handles auth token forwarding and error responses with Italian messages",
      "useTasks hook configures 30s polling interval via TanStack Query refetchInterval",
      "useRetryTask hook invalidates task query cache on success — correct cache management",
      "StateBadge has a complete status-to-config map with fallback for unknown values",
      "TaskRow correctly gates retry button on both task_type and document_status plus permission",
      "TaskInbox handles loading, error, and empty states with Italian messaging",
      "WEAKNESS: page.tsx hardcodes a placeholder AuthUser instead of consuming shared auth context — not promotable as-is",
      "WEAKNESS: TaskRow uses plain <a href> instead of Next.js Link component — causes full page navigation, contradicting AC-5"
    ]
  },
  "test_substance": {
    "status": "strong",
    "notes": [
      "2 test files with comprehensive coverage of all acceptance criteria",
      "StateBadge.test.tsx uses parameterized tests for all 5 states plus unknown fallback — thorough",
      "TaskInbox.test.tsx is well-structured with describe blocks mapped to each AC",
      "MSW setup provides deterministic fixtures with 3 tasks covering different states",
      "Empty state, loading state, and error state are all tested",
      "Retry button visibility is tested for both permitted and unpermitted users",
      "Retry mutation trigger and error absence are verified",
      "Read state persistence to localStorage is tested including restore on mount",
      "WEAKNESS: AC-5 polling test only verifies initial data render, does not actually prove polling behavior (no timer advancement or refetch assertion)",
      "WEAKNESS: No assertion that navigation link uses client-side routing rather than full page load"
    ]
  },
  "docs_code_coherence": {
    "status": "good",
    "notes": [
      "README accurately describes all emitted files and their purposes",
      "KIT_REQ-011.md correctly summarizes scope, implementation approach, and assumptions",
      "LTC.json test cases map 1:1 to acceptance criteria with correct run commands",
      "HOWTO.md provides clear setup and execution instructions",
      "Docs mention Zustand-compatible approach for read state but implementation uses raw localStorage — minor inconsistency",
      "Docs mention Next.js Link for navigation but source uses plain <a> — inconsistency",
      "Dependencies listed in README match what the source actually imports",
      "Runtime profiles (local vs AWS) are clearly documented"
    ]
  },
  "promotion_fit": {
    "status": "good",
    "notes": [
      "File paths follow the PLAN namespace: frontend.app.workflow.inbox with components, hooks, api, types",
      "Source files include promotion target comments indicating canonical destination",
      "No new top-level roots invented — stays within frontend.app.workflow.inbox",
      "Shared module references (frontend.app.shared.api, frontend.app.shared.ui) are mentioned but not created — correct boundary",
      "page.tsx placeholder auth is a promotion blocker — must consume shared auth context at promotion time",
      "QueryClient instantiation in page.tsx should be lifted to a shared provider at promotion time"
    ]
  },
  "shared_common_assessment": {
    "status": "acceptable",
    "notes": [
      "No shared modules are created or extended — correct for this REQ",
      "References to frontend.app.shared.query and frontend.app.shared.ui are documented as upstream dependencies",
      "Inline fallbacks are provided where shared modules would be needed, enabling standalone testability",
      "No premature extraction of shared code"
    ]
  },
  "dual_mode_assessment": {
    "status": "good",
    "notes": [
      "Local mode uses MSW for API mocking — no backend required for testing",
      "AWS mode uses NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL environment variable for API routing",
      "Same components and hooks serve both modes — only configuration differs",
      "Auth token is passed as optional parameter, allowing both mock and real auth flows",
      "LTC.json documents both runtime profiles with appropriate env vars"
    ]
  },
  "blockers": [
    "TaskRow uses plain <a href> instead of Next.js Link — causes full page navigation, directly contradicting AC-5 'without full page reload'",
    "page.tsx hardcodes placeholder AuthUser — not promotable without shared auth context integration seam"
  ],
  "hardening_targets": [
    "Replace <a href> in TaskRow with Next.js Link component for client-side navigation",
    "Replace hardcoded PLACEHOLDER_USER in page.tsx with a shared auth context consumer or explicit prop injection pattern that is promotion-ready",
    "Strengthen AC-5 polling test to actually advance timers (vi.useFakeTimers + vi.advanceTimersByTime) and assert refetch behavior",
    "Lift QueryClient instantiation out of page.tsx into a shared provider pattern consistent with other frontend REQs",
    "Align docs claim about Zustand with actual localStorage implementation or adopt Zustand for read state",
    "Add a deferred E2E smoke placeholder script referencing the inbox route for integration phase"
  ]
}
